_comment: Which config VALUES buildCiConfig.js may copy verbatim from the real (qbook) configs into the committed CI config. Every other value becomes __CI_RANDOM__ (a fresh random string per GitHub run, see installCiConfig.sh) or, for a multi-line quoted value, the fixed placeholder below. A setting whose NAME matches sensitiveSettingNamePattern is never kept, whatever its value looks like, except an empty value or a pure <!substitution!> reference. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions matched against the whole value.
multiLineValuePlaceholderText: CI placeholder text: the real value lives only in the configs repository
